message.content: Proposed 3 changes — review the inline preview, then Accept or Reject.

patch.title: Convert the questionnaire to a unified bilingual (English + Chinese) format with CJKutf8 support, and sync the methods item numbering (Q1/Q2) and scale description with the questionnaire anchors.

hunks.oldText:
Q1. How satisfied are you?
Options: 1 = Very dissatisfied; 2 = Dissatisfied; 3 = Neutral; 4 = Satisfied; 5 = Very satisfied.
Q2. Would you recommend the service?
Options: 1 = Definitely no; 2 = Probably no; 3 = Unsure; 4 = Probably yes; 5 = Definitely yes.
We used a five-level scale and analyzed Question 1 and Question 2.
hunks.newText: We used a five-level scale (Q1: 1 = Very dissatisfied to 5 = Very satisfied; Q2: 1 = Definitely no to 5 = Definitely yes) and analyzed Q1 and Q2.
